Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fashionista Boutique specializes in the retail and wholesale of trendy clothing and accessories for women and children. Our operations include a physical storefront in a bustling area of New York City and a robust online presence. We maintain an inventory valued at approximately $400,000, well within the preferred underwriting guidelines. Our online sales constitute around 80% of our total revenue, allowing us to minimize cyber and fulfillment risks. Additionally, repair or alteration services are not offered; our focus remains solely on providing high-quality apparel without any significant alterations or private-label goods. We prioritize strong inventory management practices, including regular audits and a monitored central alarm system, to mitigate theft and inventory loss risks.
